EVA_UnableToComply.text: Unable to comply, building in progress.

EVA_FirePowerTechStolen.text: Fire Power Technology Stolen:  All units gain firepower upgrade.

EVA_ArmorTechStolen.text: Armor Technology Stolen:  All units gain armor upgrade.

Unit_Eva_Engineer.text: Sir, this is an engineer.  He can repair any Allied building and once inside an enemy building turn it to our side.  He is much smarter than his Soviet counterpart.

Unit_Sofia_GI.text: Commander, this Allied GI is a well trained soldier capable of quickly deploying a heavy machine gun when stationed within buildings or deployed with his sandbag nest.

Mis_A1_EvaTanyaWarning.text: Don't forget, Sir!  Order Tanya as you see fit, but we CANNOT afford to lose her. You must reach Fort Bradley before it is destroyed.

Mis_A1_EvaBridgeDestroyed.text: Looks like the bridge has been blown.  We'll have to find another way to Fort Bradley.

Mis_A1_EvaProtectStatue.text: The Soviet Navy is attacking the Statue of Liberty!  We can't let them get away with that!  Sir, is there anything you can do?"

Mis_A1_EvaReachFort.text: Doesn't sound good, Sir!  We're going to have to double-time it the rest of the way to reach Fort Bradley in time!

Mis_A1_EvaControlFort.text: Congratulations!  We've reestablished contact with Fort Bradley!  They're turning over control of the base and its troops to you.

Mis_A1_EvaBuildPower.text: We seem to have lost power, sir!  Build more power plants.

Mis_A1_EvaRepairBridge.text: Looks like the bridge has collapsed.  We'll have to get our Engineers to repair it!

Mis_A1_EvaBarrelWarning.text: Watch out for those Petroleum barrels - They seem highly unstable!  Perhaps we can use them to our advantage...

Mis_A1_EvaUrbanWarning.text: Our GI's are too exposed to enemy fire!  Maybe they should take shelter in nearby buildings!

Mis_A1_EvaTanyaDeath.text: Sir, I'm sorry to report that we've lost Tanya

Mis_A1_EvaDestroyBase.text: There's the Supply Base!  Destroy all of the buildings, and we'll buy some time for the rest of the country!

Mis_A1_EvaBaseDestroyed.text: We've done it Sir!  The Supply Base has been eliminated!

Mis_A2_Tanya.text: All right!  This beacons neutralized!  Send in the cavalry

Mis_A5_AllSoldier1.text: Thanks for rescuing us, Sir!  Our plane was shot down by Soviet anti-aircraft.  There's probably more survivors around here.

Mis_A5_AllSoldier2.text: Glad you found us, Sir!  We're freezing out here!

Mis_A5_AllSoldier3.text: Good to see you, Sir!  What are our orders?

Mis_A5_EvaMissileDestroyed.text: You can check one missile off your list, Sir!  That bird will never fly again.

Mis_A5_EvaMissileCaptured.text: Sir, we managed to capture one of the Silos - instead of destroying it!  Why don't we just turn it against the other missile Silo?

Mis_A5_EvaSpyHint.text: If you can get a Spy into one of those Tesla Generators, he can probably shut down all of the base's power for a good 30 seconds.

Mis_A5_EvaMapEnlarging.text: I'm resizing your radar to compensate for the Nuclear missile coordinates that we just recieved.  Stand by.

Mis_A5_EvaBattleLabDestroyed.text: Sir!  You just blew up the Soviet Battlelab!  Without the Missile Silo coordinates, we can't complete our mission!

Mis_A5_EvaVictorySpeech.text: Congratulations, Sir!  With both nukes neutralized, the European Alliance can join the war!  We may have just changed the course of history!

Mis_A5_SovSoldier1.text: Be on the lookout for spies, Comrade.  It seems a little quiet tonight.

Mis_A5_SovSoldier2.text: (Laugh) We dont need to worry about stupid American spies. Thats what the dogs are for.

Mis_A5_TanyaNeedSpies1.text: Looks like we're going to need some more Spies, Sir!

Mis_A5_TanyaNeedSpies2.text: Sir, could you send some Spies without neon camoflauge this time?

Mis_A5_TanyaNeedSpies3.text: Looks like Spies are becoming an Endangered Species.  Send some more!

Mis_A5_TanyaNeedSpies4.text: (Tanya swears several times and is "beeped" out) Sorry, Sir, but we need some more Spies.

Mis_A6_EvaNotLincoln.text: Hey!  Thats not Lincoln.  Theyve put a Stalin head on him!

Mis_A6_EvaTerrorAttacks.text: Sir, Several of our vehicles have been eaten by Terror Drones.  Our Service Depot can remove those nasty little things to save our vehicles.

Mis_A7_EvaNiihauFallen.text: Commander, Niihau Island has fallen.  We should prepare the rest of Hawaii for invasion.

Mis_A8_AllSoldierTurned.text: Cant concentratevoicesin my head  victory to the Soviet Union.

Mis_A8_AllSoldierFreed.text: victory to the Sovwere free!  Getem!

Mis_A8_TanyaTurned.text: Mustreachthe beaconjusta little bitfarther long live the glorious peoples Soviet state.

Mis_A9_SealNeedHelp.text: Were going to need some help getting through those defenses.

Mis_A9_SealNoTemple.text: Hot Tamale!Thats no Mayan Temple thats a Prism Cannon.

Mis_A9_SealFightersJoining.text: Sir, these freedom fighters want to join up.

Mis_A10_Einstein1.text: Hmm, I've forgotten what this button does---Please dont touch the auxiliary controls Professor they notify the commander of important events.

Mis_A10_Einstein2.text: Commander!  Look out theyre over here. ---Professor please stay off this channel.

Mis_A10_Einstein3.text: Here are the Soviets!  Get them Commander. ---Professor Einstein!  Im sure the Commander sees that.

Mis_A10_Einstein4.text: You should see this Commander! ---Professor if you touch the controls again

Mis_A10_EvaSpySat.text: Sir, if you build and deploy a spy satellite you will be able to see the entire combat area.

Mis_A10_EvaOrePurifier.text: Were rather low on resources in this location, sir.  Perhaps you should construct an Ore Purifier so we can get more out of what we have.

Mis_A12_EvaSovReinforcements.text: Attemping to jam Soviet Commands calls for help, but a few got through.  Heavier Soviet reinforcements arriving soon.

Mis_A12_EvaTransportArriving1.text: Intercepting broadcast from Soviet Command.  Romanovs panicking, sir.  Hes called for air evacuation.  The transports will arrive in 2 minutes.

Mis_A12_EvaTransportArriving2.text: Soviet evacuation transports arriving in 1 minute.

Mis_A12_EvaTransportArriving3.text: Soviet evacuation transports arriving in 30 seconds.

Mis_A12_EvaRomanovEscape.text: Sir, Romanov is calling for evacuation again.  He is trying to escape.

Mis_A12_EvaAmplifierCaptured.text: Psionic Amplifier captured.  Soviet units are defecting to our side.

Mis_A12_SoldierNoSurrender.text: We will never surrender!  Death to the Allies!

Mis_A12_TanyaNoEscape.text: We cant let Romanov get away!

Mis_S1_SofiaCrushPentagon.text: Commander, this is the first step in our glorious conquest.  Victory here is crucial!  Remember, we must crush the Pentagon - above all else, the Pentagon must be destroyed!

Mis_S1_SofiaRepairBridge.text: We can't let a mere bridge delay our conquest, commander!  Order your Engineers to enter the bridge's control station!

Mis_S1_SofiaReinforcements.text: Commander, pay no heed to casualties.  For every Conscript who dies in this crusade, there are a thousand more who stand eager to replace him!

Mis_S1_SofiaUrbanHint.text: Commander, you can order your Conscripts into nearby buildings to fortify them against the enemy.

Mis_S1_SofiaDestroyPentagon.text: At last, the Pentagon is within our grasp!  Destroy it, immediately.

Mis_S1_SofiaFlakTracks.text: Ah...  Our Comrades have decided to lend us support.  These reinforcements, Commander, are some of our most useful vehicles - Flak Tracks!  Their speed, armor, and ability to carry infantry are the perfect support for our legions of Conscripts

Mis_S1_SofiaVictorySpeech.text: Superb, Commander!  The Pentagon has been destroyed!

Mis_S1_SofiaBuildPower.text: Our base is out of power!  We must build more generators to bring our radar and defenses back online!"

Mis_S1_SofiaBarrelWarning.text: Be wary of those barrels of fuel!  If damaged, they will surely explode violently.  Perhaps we can use them to our advantage...

Mis_S1_SofiaAirportHint1.text: Capture the airport commander in order to allow para-troopers to land in the area.

Mis_S1_SofiaAirportHint2.text: Excellent, Comrade Commander!  As soon as the Paratroopers are completely prepared, we will be able to strike anywhere you desire!

Mis_S1_SofiaTechBuilding.text: The building that you've just discovered is one of America's special civilian buildings.  Use an Engineer to convert the building and gain its powers.

Mis_S3_UnYuriedCiv.text: I will obey the Sovietooh!where am I?

Mis_S3_Sofia1.text: Welcome to New York, Commander. Capture the Allied Battle Lab at the World Trade Center and use their technology to build the PSYCHIC BEACON

Mis_S3_Sofia2.text: The beacon is placed, Commander, but it needs time to charge. Keep the Allies from destroying the beacon.

Mis_S3_Sofia4.text: Excellent, Commander. Now use our new conscripts to deal with the remaining Allied forces.

Mis_S4_SofiaTimerStarted.text: I have displayed the estimated time remaining until the Allied fleet arrives, Commander.

Mis_S4_SofiaBuildFlak.text: The Allied air forces are threatening our position.  Deploy our flak cannons and they will turn the enemys air units into so much scrap metal.

Mis_S5_TeslaGuy.text: Get me close to the tower and Ill take care of the rest commander.

Mis_S7_SofiaChrono1.text: Sources have reported that Allied troops are amassing outside their Chronosphere.

Mis_S7_SofiaChrono2.text: Another enemy platoon has been teleported by the Chronosphere.

Mis_S7_SofiaChrono3.text: The final Allied platoon has been teleported by the Chronosphere.

Mis_S8_SofiaBeaconDest.text: Now that the beacon is destroyed, the Americans are free from Vladimir's mind control!

Mis_S8_SofiaMonHint.text: Destroy monuments to receive a cash bonus from Moscow.

Mis_S9_Seal.text: Get the President out of here!  Go go go!

Mis_S9_President2.text: You Soviet scum, youll never take me!

Mis_S9_President4.text: You dont want the Vice President running the country, do you!?

Mis_S9_Sofia1.text: Intelligence reports that there is another bridge south of your position.

Mis_S9_Sofia2.text: Yuri is in route to your position. Clear out the enemy defenses for his arrival.

Mis_S9_Sofia3.text: Careful not to destroy the bunker, Commander. We want the President alive for interrogation.

Mis_S9_Sofia4.text: The President is on the rescue ship. Sink the ship and well fish him from the water.

Mis_S9_Yuri.text: Perhaps he needs some gentle persuasion.

Mis_S10_Sofia1.text: Greetings, Commander. Your forces need to invade the Allied base and take over their Battle Lab. Get an Engineer in there so we can pin-point the location of their Super Weapon.

Mis_S10_Sofia2.text: When your men are ready, I suggest you begin your assault here, Commander.

Mis_S10_Sofia3.text: This beach is well defended, but it is also the only place to land troops effectively. Good luck, Sir.

Mis_S10_Sofia4.text: Ah-ha, there it is! A Weather Control Device. Luckily Intel says that it couldnt possibly be operational yet. Take it out, Commander.

Mis_S10_Sofia5.text: Apparently our intelligence was wrong. Apologies, Commander. Im now downloading schematics for a Nuclear Missile Silo so you can deal with this new threat.

Mis_S10_Yuri.text: Perhaps I could be of assistance.

Mis_S11_SofiaStopYuri.text: Yuri will destroy us all. He must be stopped, no matter what the cost.

Mis_S11_SofiaIronWarning.text: (commenting on Yuris invulnerable  Iron Curtained  soldiers) Commander, Yuri must be using an Iron Curtain device to make his troops invulnerable to attack! Intel indicates that the Iron Curtain effect cant possibly be maintained for long.

Mis_S11_SofiaKirovWarning.text: Commander, looks like our Nuclear Silo's been noticed... Yuri's sending a bunch of Kirovs our way!"

Mis_S11_SofiaBuildFlakCannons.text: We'd better get some Flak Cannons in place.

Mis_S11_YuriTaunt1.text: You dont really think that War Factory will help you defeat me, do you?

Mis_S11_YuriTaunt2.text: So youre building a KirovIm impressed.

Mis_S11_YuriTaunt3.text: I wouldnt build that Psychic Sensor if I were you.

Mis_S11_YuriTaunt4.text: Youre not really planning to nuke mother Russia, are you?

Mis_S11_YuriTaunt5.text: Oh no, Terror Drones are such mindless beasts. Why dont you train an Engineer instead?

Mis_S12_Sofia1.text: Now move up the coast. There is a small airfield there where we can build a base and reclaim our captured Kirov airships.

Mis_S12_Sofia2.text: They are using the ChronoSphere to transport troops into our base! We cannot stop this assault. Attack soon, Commander, or we will be overrun!

Mis_T1_DrillSearg01.text: Good morning commander and welcome to basic training.  Theres a war on so we have to make this a crash course.  In front of you is your battle field control interface.  With this interface you can command any soldier on the field.  Let's begin with the new recruit you see in the center of your screen.  Move him away from his barracks and out into the field.  Left click on the soldier to select him.  Then left click on empty ground to move him to that location. Try not to get him killed on the way to the shooting range.

Mis_T1_DrillSearg02.text: Notice how you can order your soldier to move into the dark area surrounding the base.  This shroud indicates areas of the terrain that you have not yet explored.

Mis_T1_DrillSearg03.text: Now that you've mastered the difficult task (said sarcastically) of commanding a single soldier, try ordering around a squad.  First, select all of the men by left clicking and holding down the mouse button.  In this mode you can drag a selection box around all of your men.  Select all of the soldiers at once and order them East to the bridge.

Mis_T1_DrillSearg04.text: This bridge was destroyed yesterday when the Navy SEALs used it for demolition practice.  An engineer is en-route to repair it.  When he arrives, left click on him to select him then left click on the repair hut next to the bridge. Once the bridge is repaired, move your men across.

Mis_T1_DrillSearg05.text: This is the shooting range.  Select your men by drag-selecting a box around the group.  Once selected, left click on the targets down range.  This will order your men to fire at these targets.  Destroy all of the targets.

Mis_T1_DrillSearg06.text: Excellent, your men are good shots.  There is a row of targets just out of range of your GIs.  Double click on one of your men.   He will set himself up in a small defensive position.  In this mode he can fire at a greater range.  Many units have special abilities like this.  Now, order him to destroy the remaining targets.

Mis_T1_DrillSearg07.text: Notice that one of your men has a special symbol on him when he is selected.  This unit is a veteran unit.  Veterans are tougher, stronger and can fire more accurately than ordinary soldiers.  Double click on the man who is set up in a defense position to order him to move-out.  Now order your men to move on up the road.

Mis_T1_DrillSearg08.text: In front of you is a derelict American Grizzly Battle Tank.   Order your men to destroy the crippled tank.

Mis_T1_DrillSearg09.text: It takes your men  longer to destroy the tank than the targets at the rifle range.  Regular soldiers are not efficient at destroying armored units.  In turn, armored units may not be the most effective weapons for destroying dug in infantry.  Pick the right unit when facing enemies.  Good job today, you have completed an important part of your training.

Mis_T1_DrillSearg10.text: Hurry up commander, youre boring me.

Mis_T1_DrillSearg11.text: Keep it moving commander, your training has to go quickly, the Reds are already landing on our shores.

Mis_T1_DrillSearg12.text: Commander, this is only one soldier.  In a few days you will have to command armies.  Now left click on him and then left click on open ground to get him moving out of the base.

Mis_T2_DrillSearg01.text: Today you will fight a mock battle against another commander.  He will command the red team, you will  command the blue team.  Select your Mobile Construction Vehicle by left clicking on it then order it to move out of the base.  Move out to the East and try to find some open ground.

Mis_T2_DrillSearg02.text: Your Mobile Construction Vehicle is now in open ground. Double click on it to deploy a Construction Yard.

Mis_T2_DrillSearg03.text: Now that you have a Construction Yard you can begin to build a base.  On the right hand side of your screen you can see that the icon for a Power Plant has appeared. Left click on that icon to start construction of the power plant.  Notice how your remainng money decreases while the Power Plant is building.  Each building has a cost to construct.  When the Power Plant is done building, left click on its image and then left click on an empty area near your Construction Yard.  If you see red squares where you are trying to place it then you are either trying to place the Power Plant too far away from your Construction Yard or you are trying to build on uneven ground.

Mis_T2_DrillSearg04.text: Good, now your base has power.  Notice the power indicator on the left side of your build bar.  Each structure you build has a power cost. If your base runs short of power, some buildings will stop working, and others will work inefficiently.  Now it's time to build a Refinery so you can begin harvesting.  Ore and gems are harvested by your Miners and converted to cash.  Left click on the Ore Refinery icon.  When your Refinery's ready, place it in the same way you did with the Power Plant.

Mis_T2_DrillSearg05.text: Many buildings and units depend on one another.  Placing a Power Plant allowed you to build a Refinery and Barracks.  Placing a Barracks will allow you to train infantry. Left click on the Barracks to start its construction. When it is finished, place it on the terrain just like you did with the Refinery and Power Plant.

Mis_T2_DrillSearg06.text: On the right hand side of your screen you should see a button that looks like a soldier.  When you press that button you will see the different types of soldiers that you can train.  Right now all you can train is a GI.  Left click on the GI to start training him.  Left click multiple times to train a series of GIs.

Mis_T2_DrillSearg07.text: Red team may attack soon.  Your GIs are armed with rubber bullets for this mission.  In real combat they would of course be shooting real bullets.

Mis_T2_DrillSearg08.text: Here comes red team, make me proud commander.

Mis_T2_DrillSearg09.text: Red teams strike force has been defeated.  Now build some more soldiers commander and when you feel you are ready, move them out onto the map.  Find Red team's Command Center and destroy it.

Mis_T2_DrillSearg10.text: You really werent ready for red team were you commander?  If this had happened against the Soviets, your base would now be in flames.  Red team will pull back to give you a chance to build some more troops.

Mis_T2_DrillSearg11.text: Good job commander, you have defeated the red team.  Your basic training is complete.

Mis_T2_DrillSearg12.text: Your new Chrono Miner will automatically begin to collect ore.

Mis_T2_DrillSearg14.text: Deploy your GIs near the entrance to your base for a better defense.

Mis_T2_DrillSearg15.text: Send your troops to garrison inside the barn for better protection from enemy fire.

Mis_T2_DrillSearg16.text: Send your troops to garrison inside civilian structures for better protection from enemy fire.

Mis_T2_DrillSearg17.text: Now is not the time for potty breaks, Commander.

Mis_T2_DrillSearg19.text: WARNING: The stench of Red Team is in the air.

Mis_T2_DrillSearg20.text: Crates can be collected for special bonuses. This one contains a cash bonus.

Mis_T2_DrillSearg21.text: Your GIs can garrison inside many civilian structures. Select one of your GIs, then left click on the barn to send him in.  While garrisoned, your troops are protected from enemy fire. When the structure is severely damaged, all occupants will be ejected.

Mis_T2_DrillSearg22.text: Engineers can do more than just repair bridges. They can also repair occupyable structures and capture many enemy structures.

Mis_T2_DrillSearg23.text: To exit your soldiers from a civilian structure, select the structure then click on it again.

WWD_Allied02.text: Updating new tactical data, please stand by...

WWD_Allied03.text: Allied forces have repelled numerous Soviet assaults.

WWD_Allied04.text: Soviet forces have taken control of a number of territories.

WWD_Allied06.text: This territory is now under Allied control.

WWD_Allied07.text: The Allies are winning the battle in this territory.

WWD_Allied08.text: The Soviet Union forces control the majority of this territory.

WWD_Allied09.text: Insufficient data. Neither forces control this territory.

WWD_Allied10.text: Perhaps you should try another line of work, Commander.

WWD_Allied11.text: To reaffirm the goal is to defeat the Soviet Union, Commander.

WWD_Allied12.text: The Allies are not pleased with your performance. The President would like a word with you.

WWD_Allied13.text: A decisive victory Commander. The President will be pleased.

WWD_Allied14.text: Soviet forces have been decimated. Well done, Commander.

WWD_Allied15.text: You do your reputation justice, Commander.

WWD_Allied16.text: Status report, Commander. This territory is now controlled by the Allies. Evacuating to safe zone.

WWD_Allied17.text: Status report, Commander. This territory is now controlled by the Union. Evacuating to safe zone.

WWD_Allied18.text: Status report, Commander. This territory is now controlled by the Soviet Union. Relocating to new frontline position.

WWD_Allied19.text: Status report, Commander. This territory is now controlled by the Allies. Relocating to new frontline position.

WWD_Allied20.text: Status report, Commander. We were unable to advance through this territory.

WWD_Allied21.text: Status report, Commander. The battle is lost.

WWD_Allied22.text: Status report, Commander. We are victorious, all Soviet forces eliminated.

WWD_Allied23.text: Status report, Commander. We have stalemated with the Soviet Union.

WWD_Allied24.text: World Domination Progress Report, Commander. We are gaining ground on several key fronts.

WWD_Allied25.text: World Domination Progress Report, Commander. We were unable to stop the Soviet Union's assult on several key fronts.

WWD_Allied26.text: World Domination Progress Report, Commander. Nothing new to report. Business as usual.

WWD-Soviet03.text: The Soviets are losing ground. We may lose to the Allies if this trend continues.

WWD-Soviet04.text: The Soviets have made significant progress. The Allies are retreating.

WWD-Soviet06.text: This sector is now under control of the Soviet Union.

WWD-Soviet07.text: The Soviets have a firm grip in this territory.

WWD-Soviet08.text: We are in danger of losing this territory.

WWD-Soviet09.text: This territory is still under dispute.

WWD-Soviet11.text: The Soviet Union does not take ineffective strategies lightly.

WWD-Soviet12.text: You are not worthy to join the Soviet Union.

WWD-Soviet13.text: Excellent, the Soviets grow stronger thanks to your victory.

WWD-Soviet14.text: Romanov will be pleased with your efforts. You served the Union well.

WWD-Soviet16.text: Status report, Commander. This territory is now controlled by the Allies. Evacuating to safe zone.

WWD-Soviet17.text: This territory is now controlled by the Allies.

WWD-Soviet18.text: Status report, Commander. This territory is now controlled by the Soviet Union. Relocating to new frontline position.

WWD-Soviet19.text: Status report, Commander. We were unable to advance through this territory. Perhaps you are in need of further training.

WWD-Soviet20.text: Status report, Commander. We have been defeated.

WWD-Soviet21.text: Status report, Commander. We are victorious, all Allied forces are vanquished..

WWD-Soviet22.text: Status report, Commander. We have stalemated with the Allies.

WWD-Soviet23.text: World Domination Progress Report, Commander. Allied resistance is weakening on all fronts.

WWD-Soviet24.text: World Domination Progress Report, Commander. We are loosing ground on all fronts.

WWD-Soviet25.text: World Domination Progress Report, Commander. We have been unable to advance our position.
